kv_audit.scope: 仅核对E16/E24逐请求重算归档；每轮独立服务、运行前四卡无进程、请求盐唯一且跨两轮不重复、已记录前缀命中率均0%。这些证据不支持常规前缀缓存跨轮命中的解释，但不能排除Mamba/GDN状态残留或底层错误。未进行新的设备复测，未将隔离性或收益因果归因判为通过。Microflow与其他配置不自动继承本审计结论。
kv_audit.scope_en: Historical E16/E24 per-request recomputation controls: independent services, unique salts, no repeated salts across the two runs, and logged prefix hit rates all zero. This does not exclude Mamba/GDN state contamination or low-level faults, does not establish causal performance gains, and does not transfer to Microflow or other configurations. No new hardware test.
